note:
The coordinate descent is finished: every weight and every knob has been stepped both ways off this baseline and every step came back reject or inconclusive. So this plan does not move numbers — it asks about the one part of the search that was never questioned, only measured through: how the rollout plays.

Why the rollout and not something else. `scripts/search-shape.mjs` says the root holds 19 moves and a medium budget buys 1500 iterations, so there is no width crisis and no room for the first-play-urgency family (five attempts, none ever positive). It also says the heuristic's best drawer holds 26% of the moves and the search's own answer lands in it 38% of the time — better than chance and not much better, so a prior built on the heuristic would point away from the answer more often than towards it. That closes the two obvious search ideas without a match.

What stays open is the leaf. The depth sweep found a sharp peak — 0 plies scored 5.9%, 6 plies 39%, 18 plies 49.7%, 24 plies 42.9%, and 12 stands — which says leaf values depend heavily on how those twelve plies are played, and the policy that plays them has never been varied at all. Two ways to vary it: play worse and faster, or play the same and less repeatably.

Подрезано на ходу: `noise-006` снят, чтобы ядра раньше освободились под три признака оценки (`worth`, `circulation`, `traded`), которые уже написаны и ждут прибора. Из трёх точек шума самая малоинформативная — самая мелкая: если 0,15 ничего не дал, 0,06 не даст тем более, а 0,35 всё ещё различает «ручка инертна» и «ручка вредна».

proposals.note: A/A over the new code path. `rolloutNoise` at zero must draw nothing from the rng and change nothing at all — the golden master holds that in a unit test, but the harness is a different thing from the search, and a knob that has just been threaded through four files is worth half an hour of nothing happening. `checkEvery` cannot affect a move; anything but a coin flip here means the harness is broken and every verdict below is worthless.

Fifteen percent of rollout plies played at random instead of by the heuristic. The rollout is nearly deterministic — the heuristic keeps a quarter of the legal moves and draws inside that — so rollouts from the same leaf play much the same game, and their mean converges on the value of one line rather than of the position. That is a bias, and iterations do not remove a bias, they only measure it more precisely. Noise buys decorrelation with move quality.

The cheap heuristic in the rollout: same choice of *kind* of move, then at random inside it, skipping the distance sweeps the priority lists need. Worse plies, several times more of them per second. The flag has existed in `bot-spec.ts` since the arena was written and has never once been played — the whole rollout axis was tuned by depth alone.

The same idea, hard. If 0.15 helps, the question is immediately whether more helps more; if 0.15 does nothing, this says whether the knob is inert or merely small. Running both regardless of the first verdict, because a single point on a curve is not a curve — that is the mistake first-play-urgency cost three times.
